visual.general_description: Horizontal timeline graphic with a time axis in days and labelled clinical events, MRI sessions, HBOT, medication boxes and a transfer marker.
visual.detailed_description: A wide pale blue arrow runs left to right under the heading "Time (day)". Dark blue dots on the arrow carry printed day labels 0, 1, 9, 23, 56, 60, 81, 115, 123 and 152, each with a vertical line. Text beside the lines reads MRI (Session 1) at 9, MRI (Session 2) at 23, MRI (Session 3) at 60, MRI (Session 4) at 81, MRI (Session 5) at 115 and MRI (Session 6) at 152. Below the arrow, "Psychomotor slowing/bradyphrenia" appears under the day 23 line, "Subtle improvement (e.g., facial expressivity)" near the day 60 line and "Prominent disinhibition" near the day 123 line. A grey bar labelled "HBOT (30 sessions)" spans from the day 1 line to the day 56 line. Labels at the bottom read "Initiation of HBOT" (day 1), "Completion of HBOT" (day 56), "Diagnosis of ACOP" with a boxed "CO-Hb: 36.2%" (day 0), "Diagnosis of DEACMP" (day 23) and "Transfer to another hospital" (day 152 line). A double-headed horizontal arrow from the day 56 line to the day 152 line carries a boxed label "Recovery phase in subacute DEACMP". Two stacked grey boxes labelled "VPA (max 600mg)" and "OLZ (max 7.5mg)" lie between the day 123 and day 152 lines, closer to day 152, and the day 152 line runs through them. No faces, scans or other identifying pixels are present.

visual.general_description: Multi-panel scientific figure with cognitive score line charts (A, B), paired brain surface maps (C, D) and twelve network line charts of cortical thickness (E-J) and T1w/T2w ratio (K-P) change.
visual.detailed_description: Panels A and B at the top show normalized cognitive scores as three colored lines, with panel A marked by a black rectangle expanded in B. Panels C and D below show rendered left and right brain surfaces at four sessions with color bars. Rows E to J and K to P each show six small line charts, one per functional network (orbitofrontal/ventrolateral, frontopolar/DLPFC, DMN medial temporal, DMN core, premotor, DAN), with a bold mean line and thin subregion lines against sessions 3 to 6 and a dashed zero line.

panels.general_description: Line chart of normalized cognitive scores (percent) over the full time course with three colored series and a black rectangle marking an expanded segment.
panels.detailed_description: Axes: the y-axis is titled "Normalized cognitive score (%)" with ticks 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100; the x-axis has unlabeled tick marks. Three colored lines (orange, light blue and green) start near the upper left, fall steeply to a low point near the bottom, then rise through a jagged recovery to a plateau near the upper right where all three end at similar heights. A narrow grey vertical band sits at the far left. A black rectangle labeled "B" encloses the lower-to-right part of the curves. The green line lies below the orange and light blue lines through most of the recovery section.

pixel_observations: The panel title is "Orbitofrontal/Ventrolateral". A bold purple line starts at zero at session 3, drops below -0.025 by session 4 and stays near that low level through sessions 5 and 6, among many thin purple lines. The dashed zero line is drawn horizontally.

caption_claims.value: Caption states each bold line is the mean change in T1w/T2w (unitless) across constituent subregions.

evidence.quote: Each bold line denotes the mean change in T1w/T2w (unitless) across the constituent subregions; the thin lines denote individual subregions.

clinical_significance.statement: The authors report regionally divergent T1w/T2w changes, with increases in premotor and frontal regions and limited increase in orbitofrontal and ventrolateral regions.

evidence.quote: T1w/T2w increases in the orbitofrontal and ventrolateral regions remained limited throughout the observation period

limitations: Baseline is MRI session 3 so the session 3 value is zero by construction.
